description: Domestic Aviation Activity - Cities and Regions is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics. This file provides data on Regular Public Transport (RPT) Domestic Aviation Activity in Australia by sector type. Each sector is classified using the ABS Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) 2016 based on location of the airport pair. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics. Its tags are Transport Economics, Transport Planning, aviation statistics, domestic aviation activity, regional aviation activity. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, TXT. The portal shows 2023-08-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
